sources.snippet: This repository packages the Blackfrost-AI SGLang compatibility layer and the reversible pass-2 runtime intervention used to serve MiMo V2.6 Pro MOPD on NVIDIA Blackwell. It is a runtime package, not a model checkpoint. Model weights, tokenizer files, prompt text, captured activations, evaluation traces, compiled kernels, and deployment credentials are not included.
